description: Header file implementing CUDA kernels for memory-efficient attention in transformer models, including kernel parameter definitions, shared memory management, masking, dropout, and softmax computations.

classes.name: AttentionKernel
classes.description: Template struct implementing CUDA kernels for memory-efficient attention with support for dropout, bias, masking, and softmax, parameterized by data type, architecture, and kernel configuration.

methods.name: attention_kernel
methods.description: Main CUDA kernel function performing attention computation, including matrix multiplications, masking, dropout, softmax, and output processing.

methods.name: advance_to_block
methods.description: Prepares kernel parameters for processing a specific batch, head, and query block, adjusting pointers and dimensions accordingly.

methods.name: check_supported
methods.description: Checks if the current kernel configuration and input parameters are supported on the device.

methods.name: iterative_softmax
methods.description: Performs numerically stable softmax iteration over the attention scores in registers, updating max values, scaling, and accumulating sums.

methods.name: epilogue_shared_storage
methods.description: Provides access to shared storage used during the epilogue phase of the kernel.

methods.name: lane_id
methods.description: Returns the thread lane ID within a warp.

methods.name: warp_id
methods.description: Returns the warp ID within a thread block.

methods.name: thread_id
methods.description: Returns the thread ID within a thread block.
